instruction.name: xvrepli.b
instruction.description: Replicate a signed immediate into every b element.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvrepli.b $xr0, 1; xvrepli.b $xr1, 1; xvrepli.b $xr2, 1; xvrepli.b $xr3, 1; xvrepli.b $xr4, 1; xvrepli.b $xr5, 1; xvrepli.b $xr6, 1; xvrepli.b $xr7, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 5 --core 0 --init 'li.d $r4, 0x0102030405060708; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr0, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr1, $r4; xvreplgr2vr.d $xr2, $r4' --asm 'xvrepli.b $xr0, 1; xvrepli.b $xr1, 1; xvrepli.b $xr2, 1; xvrepli.b $xr3, 1; xvrepli.b $xr4, 1; xvrepli.b $xr5, 1; xvrepli.b $xr6, 1; xvrepli.b $xr7, 1'

notes: No source operand data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput only.
